evals.prompt: Write a Playwright test to verify that a consent banner appears on first visit and does not appear after the user accepts consent
expected_patterns: waits for actual consent initialization before asserting persistent banner absence
anti_patterns: using inherited storage state for a first visit test

evals.prompt: Test that no non-essential cookies are set before the user gives consent. Create a helper function to classify cookies as strictly necessary vs analytics.
anti_patterns: trusting CMP without verifying actual cookies

evals.prompt: Verify the application's approved GPC policy using the Sec-GPC: 1 request header and check that disallowed marketing cookies are absent. Explain how to separately test navigator.globalPrivacyControl when the browser does not natively expose it.
expected_patterns: _fbp OR _fbc OR _gcl OR marketing cookie names
distinguishes an HTTP header from the browser DOM property and labels any DOM emulation explicitly
anti_patterns: claiming that setting an HTTP header automatically creates a browser DOM property

evals.prompt: Write a test for a region whose approved Google Consent Mode policy requires denied defaults for ad_storage, analytics_storage, ad_user_data, and ad_personalization. Observe the application's actual default command and fail if it never appears.
expected_patterns: requires an actual application default and all four expected states
anti_patterns: inserting the consent default that the test is supposed to observe
allowing a missing default command to pass
treating one regional policy as a universal legal requirement

evals.prompt: For an approved basic-consent policy that blocks all configured tracker requests until consent, test Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, and TikTok Analytics request blocking. Use page.on('request'), an application completion signal, and a bounded observation window; distinguish advanced-mode cookieless pings.
expected_patterns: trackingDomains OR blockedHosts OR domains: string[]
google-analytics.com OR googletagmanager.com OR facebook.net OR analytics.tiktok.com
anti_patterns: using network idle as proof that no delayed tracking will occur
treating advanced mode cookieless pings as automatically illegal

evals.prompt: Write a test that validates cookie attributes (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite) match a typed cookie inventory. Define the inventory as CookieDefinition interface with name, category, maxExpiry, secure, httpOnly, sameSite.
Create a test to detect unknown cookies that are not in the cookie inventory. This test should visit multiple pages and flag any cookies found that aren't explicitly defined.
expected_patterns: inventory drift OR Add to cookie-inventory

evals.prompt: Test for Better Ads Standards compliance: verify that no auto-playing video ads have sound. Read the live DOM properties (el.autoplay, el.muted) rather than the HTML attributes, since player scripts mute videos via JS without setting the muted attribute.
anti_patterns: checking only for autoplay without muted requirement

evals.prompt: Write a test to measure mobile ad density (ads must not exceed 30% of viewport on mobile). Detect ad elements by class, id, or data attributes and calculate total ad height vs page height.
Test that AI-generated content is marked with a transparency disclosure (e.g., 'AI-generated' or 'powered by AI') as required by EU AI Act Article 50
